jobs.title: Performance Engineer- Software Engineer-III
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our performance engineering team. This role provides an opportunity to lead projects and contribute to high-impact software solutions that are used by enterprises and users worldwide. As a performance Engineer, you will be responsible for designing performance strategies, evaluating and optimizing complex software systems, ensuring their reliability and maintainability, and mentoring junior engineers.. You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to the technical foundation behind our flagship products and services. Responsibilities: Performance Engineering: Identify performance requirements and risks early in the development lifecycle. Execute load and stress tests, interpret results, analyze performance bottlenecks, and work with the team to improve response times, throughput, and resource utilization. Monitoring and Observability: Build and use monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting to understand service behavior. Define and review service health indicators, use telemetry to detect performance regressions, and make systems easier to diagnose in production. Project Management: Be able to manage performance execution and delivery of features and projects, negotiating project priorities and deadlines, ensuring successful and timely completion, with quality. Code and Runtime Optimization: Analyze application and system behavior to find inefficient code paths or resource usage. Recommend and implement optimizations, then validate their impact through measurement and testing. Performance Troubleshooting: Investigate complex performance issues using profiling and diagnostic tools, including heap and thread dump analysis. Identify root causes and drive fixes and preventive measures. Architectural Design: Participate in or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders, and contribute to the architectural design of new features and systems. Consider scalability, reliability, maintainability, observability, and performance throughout the design process. Mentorship: Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and growth. Code Review: Review code developed by other engineers, provide constructive feedback, and maintain a high bar for technical excellence. Promote coding guidelines, elegant and efficient implementations, maintainability, observability, and unit testing. Testing: Develop and maintain performance test scripts and automation using tools such as LoadRunner, NeoLoad, JMeter, and JavaScript-based frameworks. Debugging and Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues to ensure high-quality service operations. Service Health and Quality: Maintain service health and quality, proactively identifying and resolving issues. Use service health indicators and telemetry to recommend improvements to reliability and performance. Lead thorough root cause analyses and implement measures to prevent recurrence. Documentation: Document new features, enhancements, fixes, and relevant performance findings. Contribute to technical documentation and training materials. Innovation: Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, advocating for their adoption where appropriate to improve innovation and productivity within the team (e.g., Copilot). Minimum Qualifications: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience either in software development or performance engineering, preferably in a product-based or SaaS organization. Deep expertise in one or more programming languages such as C, C++, C#, .NET, Python, Java, or JavaScript. Hands-On experience with software development practices and in workload modeling, performance test planning, scripting, test execution, monitoring, and results analysis. Proficiency with performance testing and APM Tools such as LoadRunner, NeoLoad, JMeter, k6, Grafana, Dynatrace. Use APM and diagnostic tools such as Grafana, Datadog, dynatrace, Fiddler, browser developer tools, and platform monitoring solutions to identify bottlenecks and performance risks. Proven track record of delivering complex software projects on time and within budget. Proficiency with version control systems like GitHub and bug/work tracking systems like JIRA. Understanding of cloud technologies and DevOps principles. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment. Preferred Qualifications: Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or GCP. Familiarity with GitHub, CI/CD pipelines and automation tools. Knowledge of agile development methodologies. Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide junior engineers. Commitment to continuous learning and professional development. Familiarity with developing accessible technologies. Dedicated to diversity and inclusion initiatives. Work hours: Must be able to overlap with US business hours as required by the team 4-9 Yrs Application, Load runner, Monitoring tools, Application Performance Management, Load, Neoload, Appdynamics, Center

jobs.description: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Staff Software Engineer to join the engineering team for the Ready product. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will be a strong individual contributor and technical anchor for the team. You will contribute directly to design and implementation, help shape the technology stack, support the technical roadmap, and partner with engineers, architects, product managers, and engineering leaders to deliver high-impact product capabilities. This role requires deep proficiency in Java, strong database technology experience, strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, and the ability to learn new technologies quickly. The ideal candidate is comfortable going deep into code, production behavior, performance bottlenecks, observability data, and system design while helping the team make sound technical decisions. Responsibilities Hands-on Software Engineering Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality backend services, APIs, distributed components, and cloud-native capabilities for the Ready product. Write clean, maintainable, performant, and well-tested code using Java and modern enterprise engineering practices. Take ownership of complex technical deliverables from design through implementation, testing, release, and production support. Contribute to code reviews, design reviews, and engineering discussions with a focus on quality, simplicity, scalability, and maintainability. Quickly learn and apply new technologies, frameworks, tools, and platform capabilities as product and engineering needs evolve. Technology Stack & Technical Roadmap Contribute to the evaluation, selection, and evolution of the technology stack for the Ready product, including application frameworks, database technologies, messaging, caching, observability, and cloud-native services. Partner with architects and engineering leaders to shape a practical technical roadmap that improves scalability, reliability, performance, developer productivity, and customer experience. Bring strong technical judgment to build-versus-buy decisions, framework selection, modernization efforts, and platform evolution. Help translate product and business needs into sustainable technical designs and implementation plans. Architecture & Design Design scalable and resilient software components that align with enterprise SaaS architecture principles. Contribute to architecture discussions for distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven workflows, data-intensive features, and integration patterns. Identify design risks early and recommend pragmatic solutions that reduce complexity while supporting long-term product growth. Document technical designs, trade-offs, assumptions, and implementation approaches clearly for engineering teams. Observability, Troubleshooting & Operational Excellence Use observability platforms, logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts to understand system behavior and diagnose production issues. Troubleshoot complex technical problems across application, database, infrastructure, integration, and deployment layers. Analyze performance bottlenecks using profiling, load testing, benchmarking, database execution plans, and production telemetry. Design reliable and scalable data models using relational database technologies and appropriate data access patterns. Collaborate with teams to improve throughput, latency, resiliency, cost efficiency, and scalability of product services. AI-First Engineering & Agents Apply AI-assisted development tools to improve software design, coding, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and developer productivity. Bring practical understanding of AI trends, agents, coding assistants, and intelligent automation into engineering discussions. Identify opportunities where AI and agents can improve engineering workflows, support diagnostics, automate repetitive tasks, or enhance product capabilities. Follow responsible AI practices with attention to security, privacy, quality, reliability, and governance. Technical Collaboration & Mentorship Collaborate closely with engineers, architects, product managers, quality engineers, SRE, and engineering leaders to deliver reliable product capabilities. Lead focused technical discussions when needed, especially around design choices, implementation approaches, troubleshooting, and performance improvements. Mentor engineers through code reviews, design feedback, debugging support, and sharing of engineering best practices. Influence team-level engineering quality through strong hands-on contribution, technical credibility, and practical guidance. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience building enterprise-scale software products. Strong hands-on proficiency in Java, backend service development, object-oriented design, concurrency, performance tuning, and modern Java frameworks. Strong experience with database technologies, SQL, schema design, indexing, query optimization, transaction management, and database performance troubleshooting. Experience designing and developing distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, event-driven components, and cloud-native applications. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Strong understanding of observability, monitoring, logging, tracing, metrics, alerting, and production diagnostics. Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues across application, database, infrastructure, and integration layers. Strong understanding of performance engineering, including profiling, load testing, caching, query tuning, and scalability analysis. Ability to learn new technologies quickly and apply them effectively in production-grade software development. Practical understanding of AI-assisted engineering tools, AI agents, and emerging automation capabilities. Strong communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and mentoring skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience working on large-scale enterprise SaaS products serving global customers. Experience contributing to technical roadmaps, platform modernization, cloud transformation, or technology stack evolution. Experience with Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Infrastructure as Code. Hands-on experience with observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Kibana, Splunk, Datadog, or similar platforms. Experience with distributed caching, messaging platforms, asynchronous processing, and event-driven architecture. Strong understanding of secure software development, authentication, authorization, data protection, and enterprise integration patterns. Experience using AI coding assistants, engineering agents, intelligent automation, or AI-enabled operational tooling. Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers while remaining deeply hands-on in design, coding, debugging, and delivery. Key Attributes Strong hands-on developer who is ready to write code and solve hard technical problems. Fast learner who can evaluate and adopt new technologies pragmatically. Production-minded engineer with strong focus on reliability, observability, scalability, performance, and security. jobs.description: AI Engineer - Senior Field Details Location Abu Dhabi and Dubai, UAE Engagement Model Full-time Language Arabic, English Employment Type OCS Duration 6 months Role Summary AI only earns trust in government when it is accurate, explainable and secure. The Senior AI Engineer leads the design, build and deployment of production-grade AI and GenAI solutions on governed, high-quality data. They own the technical architecture and quality of AI solutions end to end, turning complex use cases into reliable applications that are measurable, auditable and compliant with UAE AI and data regulation. The role works alongside business analysts, data architects, data engineers and the Data Governance Council, and acts as the technical lead and mentor for junior AI engineers. Its job is to take AI from prototype to production at scale, using the Microsoft Azure AI ecosystem on top of the Purview-governed data foundation, and to set the engineering and responsible-AI standards the team follows. Key Responsibilities Lead the end-to-end design, development and deployment of AI/ML and GenAI applications, including RAG assistants, document intelligence, classification, prediction and Arabic/English NLP use cases, from use-case shaping through to production operations. Architect enterprise-scale retrieval-augmented generation solutions using Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, vector indexing, hybrid retrieval and re-ranking, agentic and prompt orchestration, and grounding on curated Gold-layer data, optimising for accuracy, latency and cost. Define and operationalise responsible-AI controls covering explainability, bias testing, content safety, hallucination controls and human-in-the-loop review, aligned to the UAE Charter for the Development and Use of AI and Dubais AI ethics principles, and present them to the Data Governance Council. Design secure, scalable APIs and integration patterns that connect AI capabilities with enterprise applications, portals and analytics, with role-based access, data masking, private networking and identity controls enforced. Partner with data architects and data engineers to define AI-ready data products, feature pipelines and data-quality gates, and ensure training and grounding data meets DQ and classification controls. Establish the evaluation framework: accuracy, relevance, latency and cost KPIs, automated regression testing, red-teaming and go/no-go release criteria applied before each release. Own CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, monitoring, drift detection, observability and cost management for AI workloads in production. Lead the application of UAE PDPL, Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR requirements to AI workloads, including threat modelling, data residency, PII handling and prompt/response logging, in coordination with security and data-protection teams. Act as technical lead for the AI workstream: lead and mentor junior AI engineers, run design and code reviews, set engineering standards and best practices, and support estimation, planning and delivery quality. Advise senior business and technology stakeholders on AI feasibility, risk, roadmap and trade-offs, and translate business needs into clear technical solutions and delivery plans. Produce and review model cards, solution architecture and design decisions, runbooks and audit evidence for each AI component. Lead capability building for Clients counterparts in AI engineering practices, tooling and responsible-AI operations so that solutions can be sustained after handover. Must Have AI certification. 8+ years in software engineering, with at least 4 years designing, building and deploying AI/ML or GenAI solutions in production, including ownership of multiple enterprise-scale deployments. Proven experience as a technical lead, guiding and mentoring a team of engineers and owning solution architecture and delivery quality. Expert-level Python skills, with deep experience in frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, PyTorch, scikit-learn or Hugging Face, and in building agentic and multi-step LLM workflows. Deep hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning and vector databases, including hybrid retrieval, evaluation and fine-tuning approaches. Strong experience designing scalable APIs and services (REST/FastAPI), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code. Strong command of MLOps/LLMOps, model evaluation, prompt engineering, red-teaming, observability and responsible-AI practices. Solid understanding of lakehouse architecture, Microsoft Fabric and governed data consumption through Purview. Working knowledge of UAE AI and data regulation, including the UAE AI Charter, UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR, with experience applying it in delivery. Excellent English communication, documentation and stakeholder-management skills. Good to Have Arabic proficiency and Arabic NLP experience. Relevant Microsoft Azure AI or architecture certifications (for example Azure AI Engineer Associate or Azure Solutions Architect Expert). Experience in government or other regulated sectors. jobs.title: Power BI SDET / Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Role Summary We are looking for a Power BI SDET who combines strong manual testing fundamentals with a growing automation and AI-assisted quality engineering practice. You will own the quality of Power BI semantic models, reports, and data pipelines for lululemon's retail analytics, making sure the numbers business users rely on are accurate, performant, and trusted. You will also help shape how the team uses Microsoft Copilot (Power BI and Fabric) and agentic AI to validate reports, generate test assets, and speed up regression cycles, while testing the AI-driven experiences themselves. Key Responsibilities Manual and functional testing (core of the role) Design and execute test plans, cases, and exploratory sessions for Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models. Validate DAX measures, calculated columns, KPIs, and business logic against source systems and business definitions (sell-through, units per transaction, inventory turns, comp sales, margin, and similar). Perform data reconciliation between source systems (ERP, POS, e-commerce, warehouse) and the reporting layer. Test row-level security (RLS) and object-level security by persona, such as store manager, regional lead, merchandiser, and executive. Test slicers, drill-through, bookmarks, cross-filtering, tooltips, and visual behavior across browsers, devices, and the Power BI mobile app. Validate refresh behavior (scheduled and incremental), gateway connectivity, and data freshness. Log, triage, and track defects in Azure DevOps or Jira, with clear repro steps and business impact. Run UAT with business stakeholders and sign off on release readiness. Test automation Build automated data validation and regression suites using SQL, Python, and/or PySpark. Automate semantic model testing with DAX queries, Tabular Editor and Best Practice Analyzer rules, and the XMLA endpoint. Integrate automated checks into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) with Power BI deployment pipelines and Git-based source control (PBIP / TMDL). Automate UI and report smoke tests where practical (Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent). Establish performance baselines using Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio, and Fabric capacity metrics. AI-infused quality engineering Copilot: Use Copilot in Power BI / Fabric to accelerate test design, DAX review, measure explanation, and report summaries, and independently verify its outputs. Testing AI outputs: Test Copilot-generated content (narratives, DAX suggestions, Q&A responses) for accuracy, hallucination, consistency, and security/data-exposure risks. Agentic AI: Apply agentic patterns, such as agents that generate test cases from requirements, run reconciliation checks, triage failures, or draft defect reports, with a human in the loop. Guardrails: Help define guardrails, evaluation criteria, and acceptance thresholds for AI-assisted analytics features. Responsible AI: Document responsible-AI practices for testing, including data privacy, prompt and output logging, and bias checks. Collaboration Work with BI developers, data engineers, product owners, and lululemon business stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment. Contribute to test strategy, definition of done, and quality gates for the analytics platform. Mentor junior testers on moving from manual to automated and AI-assisted approaches. Required Qualifications 5+ years in software or data testing, with substantial hands-on manual testing experience (functional, regression, exploratory, UAT). Practical experience testing Power BI reports and semantic models, including DAX, RLS, and refresh/deployment behavior. Strong SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation. Solid understanding of data warehousing and BI concepts (star schema, ETL/ELT, dimensions and facts, slowly changing dimensions). Experience with defect and test management tools (Azure DevOps, Jira, or Xray). Working knowledge of at least one scripting language, preferably Python, for test automation. Exposure to CI/CD concepts and Agile delivery. AI: Working knowledge of Copilot (Power BI, Microsoft 365, or GitHub Copilot) and a clear understanding of agentic AI concepts: agents, tools, orchestration, human-in-the-loop, and evaluation. Excellent communication skills and comfort working directly with client stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Microsoft Fabric experience (Lakehouse, Warehouse, Dataflows Gen2, Pipelines, Direct Lake). Experience with Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, ALM Toolkit, or Power BI REST/XMLA APIs. Hands-on experience with agent frameworks or tooling (Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangChain) or prompt-based test generation. Experience with data quality frameworks (Great Expectations, dbt tests, Soda). Retail, e-commerce, or consumer brand analytics experience (merchandising, inventory, omni-channel, loyalty). Certifications: PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer), AI-900 or AI-102, ISTQB. What Success Looks Like (First 6-12 Months) A documented, repeatable Power BI test strategy covering manual, automated, and AI-assisted validation. Measurable reduction in report defects reaching production and in regression cycle time. Automated data reconciliation checks running in the deployment pipeline. A governed approach to testing Copilot and AI-generated analytics, with defined accuracy and safety criteria. Stakeholder trust in the numbers, reflected in fewer "which number is right?" escalations. Tools and Technologies BI and data platform Power BI Desktop/Service, Microsoft Fabric, DAX, SQL Automation and scripting Python, PySpark, Playwright / Selenium Model and performance tooling Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, ALM Toolkit, Performance Analyzer DevOps and test management Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jira / Xray AI and Copilot Copilot (Power BI, Fabric, GitHub, Copilot Studio), Azure AI Foundry 5-9 Yrs Power BI, AI driven, SDET, Dax, Selenium, Pyspark, Ci/Cd, Azure DevOps
